beats.title: Packs
say: This is a Pack, on Limitless. And here is exactly how it works.

beats.title: One ticket.
beats.name: Example Pack from the app, 3 Oct
say: A Pack bundles predictions from different matches into one single ticket.
The multipliers stack.
Albania,
Croatia,
Switzerland.

beats.title: All or nothing
beats.note: You can never lose more than you put in
say: The catch: every leg has to win. One miss, and the whole Pack loses.
The good news: you can never lose more than you put in.
To start, sign in with email, Google or X. Limitless sets up a wallet for you, and covers the gas.
Then add USDC on the Base network.
Open Packs, and choose one made by Limitless.
Enter your amount, and check what it returns. Ten dollars on a 17.2 times Pack returns 172 dollars.
Then hit Buy.

beats.title: Track it. Claim it.
say: Your Pack goes from pending, to active, with a live count of legs won.
If every leg wins, press Claim, and the winnings go to your wallet.
Want your own? Under Create Your Own Pack, tap outcomes from two to five different matches.
Buy it, then share it with your followers.

beats.title: PvP: fan vs fan
beats.sub: Challenge someone on a match moment
say: There's also PvP. Challenge another fan on a match moment, like the next goal, or a card.
They put in the same amount, and the winner takes both. It starts from one dollar.

beats.title: The numbers
beats.fine: Limits can change: check the app before you buy
say: The numbers. Right now, the app takes 5 to 70 dollars per Pack.
Multipliers stop at 20 times, the biggest win is 1,400 dollars, and a 10% fee is already built into the multiplier you see.

beats.title: Use it smartly
items: Every extra leg is another way to lose
Check the multiplier before you buy
The fee is already in the number
What you see is after the 10%
Only use money you can afford to lose
say: Use it smartly. Fewer legs win more often.
Check the multiplier before you buy, because it moves. And there's no cash-out, so only use money you can afford to lose.
